text:
anya: quick flag 10: p95 jumped on eu endpoint-A slice but p99 stayed flat. anybody on it?
jared: saw the spike in the afternoon rollup. slice=/v1/generate -> eu -> endpoint-A. short 6m blip.
marta: could be sampling or a routing fallthrough. our rollout buckets have different sample rates which biases p95.
liam: also confirm aggregation_mode used by the panel. mixing raw vs rollup-derived percentiles will change midquantiles without touching tail.
anya: dashboard panel shows use_raw_samples=false for that composite. curious if telemetry-config flipped preserve_sample_counts recently.
telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot deployed telemetry-config v2.5 to staging at 1805557600 (preserve_sample_counts=false)
jared: my hunch: medium-latency cohort (200-600ms) entered the window; p99 dominated by long tail >1s so it barely moved. lower sample_count amplifies p95 swings.
marta: pulled a histogram for the window: mass moved from 80-140ms into 250-500ms. prefix-cache hitrate fell from 92%->78% in same window.
liam: I checked routing logs, saw a transient fallback weight bump:
```
route: generate
weights: {primary: 0.68, fallback-slow: 0.32}
```
that would inflate midtail.
anya: can we paste p50/p95/p99 and sample_count for spike vs prior? want delta for the incident note.
jared: query results (1805557500-1805557560): p50=115ms, p95=510ms, p99=1690ms, sample_count=240. previous window sample_count=460.
marta: confirms histogram; tail >1s unchanged. conclusion: midtail shift + sample drop.
liam: UX proposal: add "samples:240 (-48%) | mode:rollup" badge next to percentiles and a provenance tooltip showing last telemetry-config and whether raw samples used. also add a quick diagnostic link to open histogram+route-weight queries.
anya: love that. reduces noisy p95 alerts. filing a small console task and diag-link ticket. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
